events.verdict: Jokić (DEN) brings his hands to Carrington's (WAS) upper back as he moves off-ball and then releases away from the defender. Jokic's arms come out slightly as he disengages, and the contact is marginal.
Westbrook (DEN) lowers his arm and makes contact with Sarr's (WAS) right arm, which affects his layup attempt at the basket.
George (WAS) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) briefly rests and removes his hands from Poole's (WAS) sides, and the contact off-ball is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) places and removes his forearm from Sarr's (WAS) sid during his driving shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Murray (DEN) jumps into the air to retrieve the loose ball when incidental contact occurs as he comes together with Champagnie (WAS).
George (WAS) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Sarr (WAS) brings his right hand forward towards the ball, and marginal contact occurs as he grazes Jokic's (DEN) arm during his driving shot attempt.
George (WAS) raises his left hand away from Jokić (DEN), and marginal brush contact occurs after Jokić's (DEN) gather into the driving shot attempt.
Carrington (WAS) and Westbrook (DEN)O engage and disengage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal
Jokić (DEN) legally contests Poole's (WAS) floater attempt.
Braun (DEN) firms up in Champagnie's (WAS) path, and marginal contact occurs as Champganie defends over the pick.
Carrington (WAS) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Denver.
Braun (DEN) firms up in Carrington's (WAS) path, and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the screen.
Westbrook (DEN) momentarily grasps and releases Carrington's (WAS) arm as they engage and disengage during the screen, and the contact is marginal.
George (WAS) retreats his left arm into the air, and marginal contact occurs with Westbrook (DEN) during his layup attempt at the basket.
Poole (WAS) establishes the ball in the frontcourt prior to eight seconds elapsing after receiving the ball in the backcourt.
Carrington (WAS) and Westbrook (DEN) engage and disengage during the inbound play, and the contact is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) firms up in Champagnie's (WAS) path and does not deliver illegal contact when setting the pick.
Westbrook (DEN) legally contests Poole's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
